headline: WNBA Playoffs Game 2: Fever and Lynx seek sweeps as Dream face elimination
whyCareReason: Caitlin Clark and Indiana can clinch a semifinal berth in Atlanta, while Napheesa Collier leads top-seeded Minnesota seeking to eliminate Washington.
teaser: Game 2 Tuesday 29 September: Fever at Dream (7:30 p.m. ET) and Mystics at Lynx (8:00 p.m. ET). Win-or-go-home pressure arrives in the WNBA playoffs.
story:
Why this one matters: Game 2 of the 2026 WNBA Playoffs opening round arrives Tuesday night with elimination hanging over two contenders.

In Atlanta, Caitlin Clark and the Indiana Fever take a 1-0 series lead into Gateway Center Arena following Sunday's 86-80 road triumph. The Dream, powered by Allisha Gray and Rhyne Howard, must defend home court to force a decisive Game 3 back in Indianapolis. Clark's poise against Atlanta's trapping defense will decide whether Indiana sweeps into the semifinals.

Meanwhile at Target Center, the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx host the Washington Mystics with a sweep in sight. Napheesa Collier dominated Game 1 with 26 points, and Cheryl Reeve's squad looks to close out the series without needing a third game.
stakes: Fever and Lynx can become the first teams to punch tickets to the 2026 WNBA semifinals with victories tonight.
rivalryAngle: Sudden-death playoff basketball: the Dream and Mystics fight for their seasons against high-flying contenders.
